effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
purpose: We need this rewritten as a serious commercial agreement for a luxury outdoor living company using an influencer / referral growth partner. This is not generic consulting. They will help drive leads for pool remodels, outdoor kitchens, turf, patios, pergolas, and landscape lighting packages. Compensation is a $7,500 monthly retainer plus 8% commission on signed deals they directly source, paid only after customer deposits clear, with clawback if a customer cancels in the first 30 days. They may use drone footage, before/after photos, ad creatives, and social clips, but all campaign assets, CRM lead data, landing pages, and paid ad accounts belong to our company unless expressly transferred in writing. They cannot make unapproved financing claims or misleading ROI promises, and all testimonial and promo language must comply with FTC rules. They get a 6-month exclusive for luxury outdoor living referrals in our metro only if they deliver at least 12 qualified leads per month. Need non-circumvention, non-solicit, confidentiality, morals/reputation clause, approval rights, reimbursement rules, dispute resolution, and tracked e-sign / revision flow.
title: Consulting Agreement
